Report to Commander Zong:
     Since your departure, we have slept with our Blades at hand, never slacking in our duties. However, few travelers have come from Liangzhou to Qinchuan, and we have found no leads on those carrying the golden peaches along this ancient path.
     Deputy Commander Zhu and his men have not responded to our messages, withholding our provisions. Previously, we agreed to support each other—our brothers guarding this desolate grassland entry to Qinchuan while his forces held the fortress leading to Chang'an, sharing resources as needed. Now it seems those were empty words, meant only for his own comfort and gain! While we brothers endure hardship without complaint, it is unjust that you, Commander, bear such burdens. Is this not a great misfortune for the Dragon Guard Army? All of us eagerly await your return to set things right.
     The important items you tasked us to prepare are ready, awaiting only your command—
